text:
maya: Sketching a 'failure catalog' for our API surfaces — chat/completions, embeddings, rerank, tool-calls. Need to lock status codes + SDK behavior for launch. Room for customer-driven exceptions. Thoughts?
aj: Quick Q: do we want 429 for both client rate limit and per-model capacity throttling, or split 429 vs 503 for capacity?
serena: Prefer a split. 429 = client-side quota/rate gating. 503 = transient infra or model_unavailable. Also add a machine-friendly 'code' field in the body for programmatic handling.
eli: Agree. Add 'retry_after' (seconds) for 429 and optionally for 503 when we can estimate. Include an 'id' for error correlation.
samir: SDKs should surface a RetryableError that uses Retry-After header + exponential backoff + jitter. Document which errors should auto-retry vs bubble up.
maya: @eli @aj can one of you drop a canonical error JSON sample we can iterate on? :pray:
aj: Sure — initial proposal (feel free to bikeshed):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "status": 429,
    "code": "rate_limit",
    "message": "Request rate exceeded for project.",
    "retry_after": 12,
    "id": "err_2026-03-20_01"
  }
}
```
aj: And for model-unavailable fallback:
```json
{
  "error": {
    "status": 503,
    "code": "model_unavailable",
    "message": "Requested model currently has no capacity.",
    "fallback": "gpt-small-quant",
    "suggested_action": "retry_or_use_fallback",
    "id": "err_2026-03-20_02"
  },
  "served_model": "gpt-small-quant"
}
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollout v0.47 to staging succeeded :white_check_mark:
serena: Edge cases: validation vs semantic errors. I propose 400 for syntactic/format validation (missing api_key, invalid json), 422 for semantic issues (invalid function schema, prompt too long, embedding dimension mismatch).
eli: That matches what teams expect. Call out these codes in the SDK exceptions: InvalidRequestError (400), UnprocessableEntityError (422).
maya: Launch checklist (high level):
- docs: mapping table for each endpoint (chat, embeddings, rerank, tools) -> canonical status + body schema
- SDK: exceptions + automatic retry policies implemented
- console: surface top error buckets (rate, model_unavailable, validation)
- e2e: tests for fallback and header propagation
aj: On fallback routing: when we hit code:model_unavailable (503), gateway should auto-route to a configured fallback model if policy allows and latency budget permits. Need config flags (allow_fallback, latency_threshold_ms, preserve_sampling_seed).
serena: Customers asked about determinism when rerouting — we should surface served_model and rollout_id in both headers and response body so apps can decide if they care. Suggest header X-Served-Model and body field served_model.
eli: Also add 409 for conflict scenarios (e.g., duplicate upsert id for rerank index, concurrent write collision).
samir: I'll start a SDK PR to map HTTP codes -> exceptions and implement Retry-After handling. Will include sample backoff snippet.
maya: Decision summary (for records): 1) Split semantics: 429=rate_limit, 503=model_unavailable/infra, 400=syntax/format, 422=semantic. 2) Response body must include 'code' (string), 'message' (string), optional 'retry_after' (seconds), 'id' (trace id), and 'served_model' when fallback/reroute occurs. 3) Gateway may auto-fallback based on policy; when it does, surface served_model + rollout_id. 4) SDKs handle retries for 429 and optionally 503 based on policy and Retry-After.
eli: Also we should include a short client-facing guidance doc snippet for retry semantics (max attempts, base backoff, jitter). I'll draft.
serena: For monitoring: classify incidents by 'error.code' and by endpoint (chat/embeds/rerank/tools). We should tag traces with model and fallback flag.
aj: One more: rate limit responses should always include Retry-After header and a quota_hint in body for quota tokens left where applicable.
maya: OK — next steps: samir + aj = SDK table PR; eli = retry doc; aj = gateway fallback config PR; serena = monitoring + dashboard mapping; maya = consolidate into spec and add to product roadmap ticket.
samir: Got it. I'll aim for PR by end of week. :thumbsup:
maya: Thanks everyone — this gives us a clear launch path and acceptance criteria. If no objections I'll lock these tradeoffs tomorrow and start writing the spec. :rocket:
